name: Creative Claw
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのプラグイン詳細画面に表示された名称
original_description:
Create videos, product ads, images and voiceovers in ChatGPT. Animate a photo, turn a script into a multi-scene film, or make a creator-style product ad with narration and captions. Built for marketers, creators and small teams who need on-brand media without leaving the conversation.

Plan shots and storyboards, prepare consistent reference images, generate clips and assemble a first cut. Turn interviews and longer videos into social clips, cut and reorder selected moments, reframe for vertical formats, and add captions. Transcribe audio, video files and public video links. Ask for motion graphics, kinetic typography or an animated explainer, and a video agent designs and renders it with voiceover, music and sound.

Create a reusable avatar from your photos or a fictional character brief. Review its character sheet, save it as a Character, and reuse its visual references in images and videos. Give a Character a voice: design a new synthetic voice from a description, clone your own voice (or a speaker's voice with their explicit permission) from a clean recording, or choose a stock voice for multilingual narration. Sync speech to on-screen lips, and add music and sound effects to the same project.

Generate and edit supporting images, product photos and campaign visuals. Use reference images to guide product appearance, character identity, composition and style. Several image, video and voice models are available; availability and settings vary.

Video Review mode shows the proposed prompt, references and settings before you press Generate. It reviews the request, not a rendered video preview. Auto mode submits the requested generation immediately.

Results, character consistency and voice similarity vary. You can send feedback from the conversation. For help, contact support@creativeclaw.co.
description_scope: ChatGPTの詳細画面で展開した提供元の英語説明

limitations_ja: 提供元は、他者の声を複製する場合は本人の明示的な許可に言及。映像の事前確認モードは生成依頼の内容を確認するもので完成動画のプレビューではないと説明。品質・利用可能なモデルは変動すると記載。
